title: Fresh verified change apply-request gate
goal: Allow only exact-base FRESH verified change candidates to request apply admission through Trust Canal without applying the patch.
laws: Candidate must be VERIFIED_CHANGE_CANDIDATE and non-applied.
Current canonical target SHA must exactly equal candidate base SHA.
STALE_BASE is rejected before durable apply admission.
Apply request binds candidate ID, mission ID, patch digest and target SHA.
Trust Canal admission of apply request does not apply any patch.
